name: Mass General Brigham
notes: Researched from public massgeneralbrigham.org billing pages (no sign-in). One combined bill covers MGH, Brigham and Women's, Faulkner, Cooley Dickinson, Martha's Vineyard, Mass Eye and Ear, McLean, Nantucket, Newton-Wellesley, NSPG, Salem, Spaulding, Wentworth-Douglass and MGB community physicians/home care/urgent care; affiliated private practices bill separately. Pay in Patient Gateway (Epic MyChart; payments post immediately), as a guest, by phone 617-726-3884 press 1 (account number + patient DOB), or by mail to P.O. Box 418393, Boston, MA 02241-8393. Visa, MasterCard, Discover, Amex and e-check. Bills every 30 days after insurance; 25 days to pay in full. Paperless and monthly payment plans are in Patient Gateway. AutoPay is not mentioned publicly (family default kept). No payment fees stated. Billing Solutions hours M/Tu/W/F 8-4:30, Th 9-4:30. Guest lookup fields are not stated (family default).

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Log in to Patient Gateway to see all open balances and pay; online payments post right away. You can also pay as a guest without logging in.
By phone, call Billing Solutions at 617-726-3884 and press 1; have the account number and the patient's date of birth ready.

By mail, send a check or money order with the statement coupon to Mass General Brigham, P.O. Box 418393, Boston, MA 02241-8393. Write the account number, not the medical record number, on the check. Checks sent to other addresses may not post.
Mass General Brigham accepts Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express and electronic checks.

help.title: One bill for Mass General Brigham care
paragraphs: A single statement covers care at Massachusetts General Hospital, Brigham and Women's, Brigham and Women's Faulkner, Cooley Dickinson, Martha's Vineyard, Mass Eye and Ear, McLean, Nantucket Cottage, Newton-Wellesley, Salem, Spaulding Rehabilitation, Wentworth-Douglass, North Shore Physicians Group and Mass General Brigham community physicians, home care, integrated care and urgent care. Affiliated private practices bill separately.
Bills go out every 30 days, after insurance has processed the claim (uninsured patients are billed directly). You have 25 days from receiving a bill to pay it in full; the due date is on the bill.

help.title: Payment plans and paperless bills
paragraphs: Mass General Brigham can arrange flexible payment plans on request. In Patient Gateway you can set up a monthly payment plan and choose to go paperless and get bills online.

help.title: Contact Billing Solutions
paragraphs: Patient Billing Solutions: 617-726-3884, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Thursday 9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. General questions can go to the patientbilling email (replies within about three business days); use Patient Gateway for account details and payments.
Insurance updates: Patient Services Center at 866-489-4056. Written correspondence (no checks) goes to Patient Billing Solutions, 399 Revolution Drive, Suite 410, Somerville, MA 02145-1462.

help.title: Financial assistance
paragraphs: If you cannot pay your medical bills, Mass General Brigham offers financial assistance and patient financial counselors. See the Financial Assistance page for options and how to apply.

extra.intent: Using the Mass General Brigham billing help, find how many days you have after receiving a bill to pay it in full. Do not make a payment or change anything.
Find the P.O. Box number where Mass General Brigham wants mailed check payments sent. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
